description.value: The Artful Dodger is a neighbourhood pub in Langley, BC, serving a full food and bar menu alongside an on-site liquor store. It runs a community shuttle service on Friday and Saturday evenings within 10km, reflecting its strong local character in the Fraser Valley. Touring cyclists can stop in for a sit-down meal or call ahead for takeout.
